name: IRCCWMania II

date.source: The post's own dateline; a five-part transcript of the fed's own second annual pay-per-view.

notes: Real-wrestler-portrayal roster: Stone Cold Steve Austin retains the World Heavyweight Championship over Hollywood Hulk Hogan; Chris Benoit wins the North American Heavyweight Championship from Scott Hall in a steel-cage War Match; Hakushi retains the Cruiserweight Championship in a three-ladder match; Harlem Heat retains the World Tag Team Championship over The Gangstas; Kronus & Saturn (the Eliminators) win the inaugural Continental Tag-Team Championship over Deadly Force (Big Bubba Rogers & Bam Bam Bigelow) in a Philadelphia street fight.
